cards.title: Type change classification and policy metadata
cards.paragraph: `Review` now includes `classification: Classification` and `verdict: Verdict`; `Classification` records the change kind, areas, maximum attention, sensitive paths, and file/block/inert counts, while `Verdict` records a low/medium/high tier, required human count, and reasons. `Config` now requires a `policy: Policy` field.

cards.title: Test policy classification and evaluation
cards.paragraph: `dispatch.test.ts` now builds each `Review` with `classification` from `classify` and `verdict` from `evaluate`, and supplies `DEFAULT_POLICY` in test configs. New `policy.test.ts` cases cover tier and human-count evaluation, change-kind and area classification, diff classification, schema errors, and global/repository config layering.
